ModMetaData.name: Canopy Ghost for Better Trees
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
Warning: this mod was written with AI coding tools (Claude Code).
An add-on for Better Trees. With its "Render trees over colonists" option on, a dense forest hides everyone in it; this mod makes the canopy translucent wherever something stands under it, so pawns, their weapons and carried things, items and corpses show through the leaves, fights and animations included.
Replaces all of Better Trees' own see-through effects: while this mod is loaded, Better Trees' transparency button, hotkey and modes (cursor transparency, pawn passthrough, tree ghosting) are switched off. Unsubscribe this mod if you prefer Better Trees' built-in ones.
Notes - Works with any mod that draws trees over pawns; with vanilla tree layering it does nothing. Better Trees is not required. - See-through amount, layer resolution and refresh can be set in the mod settings. - Safe to add to or remove from an existing save.
